scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types tests/paths.test.mts && node tests/engine.test.mjs && node tests/dom.test.mjs
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch src --watch sites --ext ts,css,json --exec "npm run build:all"
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:all && npm run lint && concurrently "npm run watch" "node node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js run -s build/firefox"
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run build:all && concurrently "npm run watch" "node node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js run -t chromium -s build/chrome --chromium-binary /usr/bin/chromium"
